profile.summary: Next Generation Learning Challenges (NGLC) is an education initiative that raises grant funding and supports school redesign. Its programs include Learning Excursions, where educators and students visit innovative schools, and tools that use artificial intelligence to support learner-centered education. It operates through Tides Center as its fiscal sponsor and is housed within LEAP Innovations.
